title: Integrated Bioinformatic Analyses Reveal Immune Molecular Markers and Regulatory Networks for Cerebral Ischemia-Reperfusion.
authors: Guo, Qixin; Du, Anning; Wang, Jiayue; Wang, Luyang; Zhu, Xu; Yue, Xin; Liao, Shengen; Shi, Mengsha; Qu, Qiang; Cheang, Iokfai; Li, Xinli; Pang, Hui; Tong, Guoxin
one_liner_zh: 该文用生物信息学分析脑缺血再灌注的免疫分子标志物与调控网络，虽含转录因子-miRNA-基因网络和分子对接，但核心是疾病标志物而非蛋白质-DNA互作机制，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Cerebral ischemia-reperfusion injury (CIR) following a stroke results in secondary damage and is a leading cause of adult disability. The present study aimed to identify hub genes and networks in CIR to explore potential therapeutic agents for its treatment. METHODS: Differentially expressed genes based on the GSE23163 dataset were identified, and weighted gene co-expression network analysis was performed to explore co-expression modules associated with CIR. Hub genes were identified by intersecting immune gene profiles, differentially expressed genes, and modular genes. Gene Ontology, Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes pathway, and transcription factor-microRNA-gene regulatory network analyses were then conducted in selected crucial modules. Subsequently, their expression levels in animal models were verified using real-time quantitative polymerase chain reaction and Western blotting. Finally, potential drug molecules were screened for, and molecular docking simulations were performed to identify potential therapeutic targets. RESULTS: Seven hub genes-namely, Ccl3, Ccl4, Ccl7, Cxcl1, Hspa1a, Cd14, and Socs3-were identified. Furthermore, we established a protein interaction network using the STRING database and found that the core genes selected through the cytohubba plugin remained consistent. Animal experiments showed that at the transcriptional level, all seven genes showed significant differences (p < 0.001, fold change vs sham, 5-200). At the translational level, however, only Ccl3, Ccl4, Ccl7, Hspa1a, and Socs3 showed significant differences, while Cxcl1 and Cd14 did not. Nifedipine, with the highest predicted score, was identified as a therapeutic agent and successfully docked with the protein encoded by the hub genes. CONCLUSIONS: The expression of Ccl3, Ccl4, Ccl7, Hspa1a, and Socs3 was significantly different in CIR tissues compared to normal tissues both at the transcriptional and translational levels. Systems biology approaches indicated that these could be possible CIR marker genes, providing a stepping stone for further experimental studies.
abstract_zh: 背景：卒中后的脑缺血再灌注损伤（CIR）会导致继发性损伤，是成人残疾的主要原因。本研究旨在识别CIR中的核心基因和网络，以探索其治疗的潜在药物靶点。方法：基于GSE23163数据集识别差异表达基因，并进行加权基因共表达网络分析，以探索与CIR相关的共表达模块。通过交集免疫基因谱、差异表达基因和模块基因，识别核心基因。随后，对选定的关键模块进行基因本体论、京都基因与基因组百科全书通路及转录因子-微小RNA-基因调控网络分析。之后，使用实时定量聚合酶链反应和Western blotting验证其在动物模型中的表达水平。最后，筛选潜在药物分子，并进行分子对接模拟以识别潜在治疗靶点。结果：识别出七个核心基因，即Ccl3、Ccl4、Ccl7、Cxcl1、Hspa1a、Cd14和Socs3。此外，我们使用STRING数据库建立了蛋白质相互作用网络，发现通过cytohubba插件选择的核心基因保持一致。动物实验显示，在转录水平上，所有七个基因均表现出显著差异（p < 0.001，与假手术组相比的倍数变化为5-200）。然而，在翻译水平上，仅Ccl3、Ccl4、Ccl7、Hspa1a和Socs3表现出显著差异，而Cxcl1和Cd14则没有。预测得分最高的硝苯地平被确定为治疗药物，并成功与核心基因编码的蛋白质对接。结论：与正常组织相比，CIR组织中Ccl3、Ccl4、Ccl7、Hspa1a和Socs3在转录和翻译水平上的表达均存在显著差异。系统生物学方法表明，这些可能是CIR的标记基因，为进一步的实验研究提供了基础。
